decisions.reason: The lever handle family builds directly on the firm's core design and fitting know-how, so the firm can read its market results well and refresh models at low cost, which favours keeping it while several sibling designs have already been culled.

This single handle design sits close to the established range and survived the 2019 pruning that removed similar designs, but as a single design rather than a family it is more exposed to the firm's routine design-portfolio turnover.

The L700 electronic access system is the flagship of the firm's move toward digital building organisation, and its in-house R&D and patented engineering let it keep improving the light technology, so dropping it would undercut its strategic direction.
